items.title: Chebyshev-Lobatto nodes and integrated coefficient certificate

source.anchor: 3.6, B1/B2 coefficient definitions and row/constant proof, HTML1684-1713; actual Algorithm3.1 consumer
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang; exact bounded ASTIS coefficient and actual phase component, not complete B1/D4/main result.

items.statement: For natural J>=2 and real h>0, enumerate i=0,...,J-1 with Fin J and set t_i=h/2[1-cos(i*pi/(J-1))], ell_j=Lagrange.basis(univ,t,j), Lambda=sup_{s in[0,h]} sum_j |ell_j(s)|, omega_ij=integral_0^{t_i}(t_i-s)ell_j(s) ds and b_j=integral_0^h ell_j(s) ds. Each node is in[0,h], the node map is injective, and t_{J-1}=h. The cardinal identity ell_i(t_j)=1_{i=j} and the constant partition sum_j ell_j(s)=1 hold for every real s. The actual compact supremum satisfies Lambda>=1. For each i, sum_j|omega_ij|<=t_i^2*Lambda/2<=h^2*Lambda/2, and sum_j b_j=h.
assumptions: Natural J>=2, real h>0. Fin J is zero-based i=0,...,J-1, corresponding to source j=i+1.

All nodes, real Lagrange polynomials, compact Lebesgue supremum and integral coefficients are constructed explicitly. The measure is real Lebesgue measure on the displayed closed-endpoint interval integral. Continuity and interval integrability are conclusions of polynomial regularity, not supplied extra assumptions.

obligations.label: Chebyshev-Lobatto nodes and integrated coefficient certificate
Classical logarithmic Lebesgue bound and nonnegative momentum weights (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Exact source coefficient construction and the row/momentum-total components of B1. No input row/Lebesgue envelope. Lambda is the actual compact supremum. Nonnegative Clenshaw-Curtis momentum weights, logarithmic Lambda<=2/pi*log J+1, polynomial remainder B2, run-wide accuracy/work and main results remain independent obligations; not complete B1.
